description: Extract a frequency-ranked, role-classified color palette from a website by statically analyzing its HTML and CSS. Returns ranked colors (hex/rgb/hsl, roles, usage counts), grouped palette roles (primary/accents/neutrals/surfaces/texts), resolved CSS custom properties, and a separate dark-scheme palette when the site ships one. Browse the full library of website DESIGN.md design systems at https://www.designmdpro.app/

limit.description: Max colors per scheme palette (default 24, max 64)

url.description: Full URL or bare domain of the page to analyze (e.g. https://linear.app or linear.app)

name: extract-color-palette
title: Extract color palette
